title: Register notification inbox tool on assistant
description: Register createNotificationInboxTool on the supervisor agent using configured storage. Verify LibSQL notification domain support with a focused test before enabling in dev. Document tool usage in assistant instructions (read action for full payload).
why: sendNotificationSignal alone does not expose full stored payloads to the model; Mastra 1.85 requires createNotificationInboxTool.

acceptance.text: Assistant registers createNotificationInboxTool with existing LibSQL storage
integration test verifies read of a seeded notification record
